text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- World Bank president James Wolfensohn will pay a two-day official visit to Bucharest.
- The central bank denied reports in the local media saying the bank's governor would resign.
- The Industry Ministry plans to restructure the Romanian Oil Company.
- British insurance companies are interested in setting up businesses in Romania, the paper says.
- Motorists in the Brasov county plan to block traffic on main roads in the county to protest against the new road tax.
- The Sidex SA steel mill in Galati will import coal from the United States worth $25 million.
